user.title: Configure conversation agent
user.description: Choose models and edit their prompts and limits in the same block. {error}

data.name: Agent name
data.answer_error_reply: Reply when the action completed but answer generation failed

data_description.excluded_entities: Home Assistant exposed-entity settings are always respected. These entities are additionally excluded.
data_description.history_enabled: Use prior user inputs and final assistant replies in every model step.
data_description.history_messages: Rolling window for this Assist conversation. Includes only user/assistant text, with no added idle expiry.
data_description.log_runs: Off by default. Save complete run records under glow_assistant/runs/successful or unsuccessful in your HA configuration directory. Includes user text, states, prompts, model requests/responses and execution details; connection credentials are redacted. Files are not automatically deleted.
data_description.answer_error_reply: Used after HA accepted the command and only answer generation failed; it must not imply the command failed.
data_description.ok_reply: Spoken confirmation for successful commands when LLM answer generation is off. Default: Okay.
data_description.yes_reply: Reply for yes/no queries when the answer is yes and LLM answer generation is off. Blank uses the pipeline-language default. Custom text is spoken unchanged.
data_description.no_reply: Reply for yes/no queries when the answer is no and LLM answer generation is off. Blank uses the pipeline-language default. Custom text is spoken unchanged.

data_description.url: Full native decisions endpoint, e.g. {openrouter_decider_url} or {local_decider_url}.
data_description.api_key: Optional for local servers without authentication. This model uses only this key.
data_description.max_input_chars: Reject larger requests without truncating candidates or state data. This counts characters, not tokens.
data_description.test_connection: Sends a model-only test request. It never executes a Home Assistant action.
data_description.service_prompt: Plain instructions; request and context are supplied separately. Clear this field to restore its default. No templating.
data_description.area_prompt: Select one or more named areas, or all_areas for the whole home or no specific room. Named areas take priority over all_areas. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.text_prompt: Select words for the current text field. other_parameters lists the other fields extracted separately; their metadata is in selected_fields. Leave their values to those extractors. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.message_prompt: Extract the message only; titles, descriptions and other_parameters are extracted separately. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.target_scope_prompt: Classify room-independent arealess entities; specific entities within one explicit or implied speaker area; explicit area(s) without specific entities; implied speaker area without specific entities; or unsure. Entity targets with an area are limited to one area. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.domain_prompt: Select one reporting domain after area selection for every state query. Clear to restore the default. No templating.
data_description.query_type_prompt: Choose yes/no or a detailed answer after area and domain selection. Clear to restore the default. No templating.
data_description.binary_answer_prompt: Answer yes/no from current candidate states, without entity keep/drop. Missing or ambiguous facts must return unsure. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.parameter_prompt: Select the optional action fields needed for the request. Multiple parameters can be retained. Clear to restore the default. No templating.
data_description.action_area_prompt: Select explicitly requested areas. Multiple areas are allowed for area-only targets; specific entities with one explicit area use the unique highest probability. Implied areas use speaker context. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.action_entity_prompt: Select requested specific entities after domain and optional area filtering. Multiple targets are allowed. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.query_target_prompt: Select every candidate entity needed to answer the request. Multiple targets can be retained. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.query_target_probability_threshold: Relative threshold (RT) for detailed state-query entities. Keep p >= this value / max(1, real entity count), excluding none/unsure. None does not override retained entities. Noul uses Decision confidence instead. Default: 0.15.
data_description.text_probability_threshold: Relative threshold (RT) for words extracted from the latest request. Keep p >= this value / max(1, real word count), excluding none/unsure. Preserve word order. None does not override retained words. Noul uses Decision confidence instead. Default: 0.4.
data_description.numeric_prompt: Extract the current numeric field using HA metadata and current settings. Ignore numbers and change amounts belonging to other_parameters. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.numeric_mode_prompt: Classify the current field as absolute, relative or unsure. Ignore other_parameters values and change verbs. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.state_property_prompt: Select the requested states or attributes. Multiple properties are allowed. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.select_prompt: Choose only the fixed values supplied by the HA select field. Use labels, request meaning and other_parameters. Clear to restore the default.
data_description.query_fallback_prompt: One recovery Choice call over all exposed entities, without area or domain filters. Respect requested rooms and select entities reporting the requested information. Multiple entities are allowed. Clear to restore the default. No templating.
data_description.max_attribute_chars: Omit each entity attribute larger than this limit from state-query context sent to the decider and smart-home answer model. Strings use character count; other values use JSON character count. Values at the limit remain; larger attributes are removed, not truncated. The original snapshot and action capability checks stay unchanged. Default: 1024.
data_description.use_noul: Use one independent Noul question per candidate, batched in one request per stage. Applies to query areas, entities, properties and fallback; action areas, entities and optional fields; text words and multiple allowed values. Single-choice and numeric decisions stay unchanged. Uses Decision confidence without division by option count. Default: off.
data_description.confidence: Shared minimum confidence (MC) for all single-choice decisions, numeric extraction and the Choice fallback gate. With Noul, keep each candidate with p(yes) >= this value. Relative probability thresholds remain separate and apply only to Choice multi-selection. Default: 0.5.
data_description.probability_threshold: Shared relative threshold (RT) for query areas, state properties and fallback entities; action areas, entities and optional parameters; and multiple enum values. Keep p >= this value / max(1, real option count), excluding none/unsure. None does not override retained options. Extra irrelevant options can admit weak matches. Noul uses Decision confidence instead. Default: 0.5.

data_description.url: Full endpoint URL; no path is appended. Localhost refers to Home Assistant itself.
data_description.api_key: Optional for local servers without authentication. This model uses only this key.
data_description.max_input_chars: Reject larger requests without truncating candidates or state data. This counts characters, not tokens.
data_description.test_connection: Sends a model-only test request. It never executes a Home Assistant action.
data_description.prompt: Plain instructions; request and context are supplied separately. Clear this field to restore its default. No templating.
data_description.enable: Off by default. When disabled, commands reply ok, yes/no queries use a fixed reply, and other queries list entity names and the selected state value. No answer-model request is made.

data_description.url: Full endpoint URL; no path is appended. Localhost refers to Home Assistant itself.
data_description.api_key: Optional for local servers without authentication. This model uses only this key.
data_description.max_input_chars: Reject larger requests without truncating candidates or state data. This counts characters, not tokens.
data_description.test_connection: Test the model connection and discover tools on enabled MCP servers. No tool is executed.
data_description.enable: When disabled, unrelated requests use the fixed unsure reply. No model request is sent.
data_description.prompt: Plain instructions; request and context are supplied separately. Clear this field to restore its default. No templating.
data_description.mcp_servers: HTTP servers only. Enable each server you want to use. Use your own proxy for stdio servers. Empty allowed-tool lists expose all advertised tools.
data_description.mcp_max_rounds: Maximum model rounds that may request tools for one user request.
data_description.mcp_max_result_chars: Reject larger tool results without retrying the tool.
data_description.mcp_max_calls: Maximum total tool calls for one user request.
